description: My name is Nguyen Huu Tung. Join me
summary: My team identifies locations on Earth that share similarities with potential sites for establishing long-term bases on the Moon and Mars, with the goal of developing experimental solutions. This work lays the foundation for ongoing research and the continuous collection of data—efforts that hold core value for addressing challenges here on Earth, while also extending the scope of problem-solving beyond the planet we inhabit.
details: The product takes the form of a website. It serves educational purposes, acting as a reference resource and research-based material that presents concepts for establishing long-term bases on the Moon and Mars.
